findings.title: Interpolating before `querySupportsSplitting` breaks `$__range` detection
findings.body: `runSplitQuery` now calls `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` on line 299 before `querySupportsSplitting(query)` is evaluated on line 300. `applyTemplateVariables` replaces `$__range`, `$__range_s`, and `$__range_ms` in `query.expr` with their literal durations (e.g. `72h`) via `templateSrv.replace`. As a result, `isQueryWithRangeVariable(query.expr)` inside `querySupportsSplitting` will always return `false` because the `$__range*` token has already been replaced, causing queries that use `$__range` to be split into daily chunks and evaluated with the full-range duration over each 1-day sub-range (or re-interpolated on the backend with the 1-day sub-range if left unreplaced). `querySupportsSplitting` needs to inspect the un-interpolated `expr` (or `isQueryWithRangeVariable` must be checked before `applyTemplateVariables`).

findings.title: Queries are interpolated multiple times and ad-hoc filters are injected repeatedly during shard splitting
findings.body: `runShardSplitQuery` now calls `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` at the start (line 52), and then for each shard batch `splitQueriesByStreamShard` delegates to `runSplitQuery(datasource, subRequest, ...)` (line 163), which calls `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` again on the already-interpolated targets (and `datasource.runQuery` -> `super.query` will call it a third time). Because `LokiDatasource.applyTemplateVariables` injects `request.filters` (ad-hoc filters) into `query.expr` on every call and re-runs template variable replacement on the already-expanded expression, ad-hoc filters will be added to the stream selector multiple times and any variable values containing `$` syntax will be re-interpolated on each shard cycle.
